changes.canonical_owner: ItemTooltipPresentation.ComposePrayerTooltip owns which PrayerClarity rows are Left versus Center. TechnologyTooltipContentWidth already owns the final rendering treatment for PrayerClarity-marked prayer-item rows. Stock WidgetsBubbleGUI owns the table's child placement and computes the bubble width from the maximum child widget width.
changes.final_writer_or_commit_point: WidgetsBubbleGUI.UpdateSizeAndWidgetsPositions is the stock commit point after all child rows have been drawn: it calls UpdateSize and then Reposition. A narrowly scoped PrayerClarity prefix can therefore measure the already-natural child widths, expand only marked Left content rows to that same existing maximum, then let stock UpdateSize/Reposition finish normally.

src/ItemTooltipPresentation.cs on baseline ef027959871b9f520cee73be88ce381306b30c10 already sets Base Result and On Success content to Left and Requirement to Center, proving the requested alignments are not mixed at the data level.

Direct stock host inspection: BubbleWidgetText.Draw applies data.alignment only to the UILabel; WidgetsBubbleGUI centers child widgets when container alignment is Center and UpdateSize sets bubble width to the maximum child size before Reposition. This explains why a short Left-aligned child still appears centered as a block.

Solution-space checkpoint: changing alignment again cannot help because it is already Left; changing container alignment would also move headers; fixed widths were repeatedly rejected. Expanding only marked Left rows to the already-existing native maximum width is the least-complex path that preserves native outer geometry.
